name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in the Salta province of Argentina, one of the largest undeveloped primary silver resources globally with 248 million ounces silver and 2.54 million ounces gold in measured and indicated resources. A Definitive Feasibility Study released in June 2026 confirmed strong project economics with a CAD$4.2B after-tax NPV5% and 42% IRR, positioning Diablillos among the premier undeveloped silver-gold projects globally. The company also holds the earlier-stage La Coipita copper-gold-molybdenum project in San Juan, Argentina, being advanced under an earn-in partnership with a Teck Resources subsidiary.
